statements.status_notes: ArgoCD 3.2.x includes the fix for CVE-2025-23216 which was integrated before the 3.2.0 release. The gitops-engine repository was archived on 2025-12-17, so no new version will be released, but the fix is present in the vendored code used by ArgoCD 3.2.x.
